name: Corbitt Manufacturing Company
old_description: Since 1948 we have supported the transportation, construction, industrial tool, farm and foodservice industries. We deliver the top-quality products you need, when and where you need it. Guaranteed.
about:
Corbitt Manufacturing Company operates from Paragould, Arkansas, where it was founded in 1948. The business began as a diversified contract manufacturer specializing in permanent-mold aluminum castings. In 2019, the company was acquired by The Greenbrier Companies and now operates as a Greenbrier subsidiary.

The 100,000-square-foot facility houses three CNC machining centers and three furnaces feeding multiple pour lines. Core capabilities include permanent-mold aluminum castings up to 75 pounds (maximum mold size 48 by 62 inches), CNC machining with wire and RAM EDM, grinding, broaching, and milling, plus captive support services such as fabrication, hot and cold forming, progressive stamping, punching, bending, and welding. The shop handles production runs from single prototypes to several hundred thousand units and offers in-house heat treating, assembly, and reverse engineering.

Corbitt serves OEMs in earth moving, mining, agricultural, electrical, transportation, recreation, food service, construction, industrial tool, farm, and powertrain/transmission sectors. In transportation, it produces dock cleats, transmission casings, manifolds, and railroad car parts. For food service, it re-engineered motor housings for garbage disposals to eliminate leakage. Electrical customers receive explosion-proof receptacles and power line connectors, while powertrain clients rely on the permanent-mold process for gearboxes requiring tight tolerances.

The company emphasizes problem-solving engineering, with a team that brings troubleshooting expertise to every project. Its in-house testing protocols enable fast-tracked deployment of parts to customer fleets, and it promotes competitive pricing across the full volume spectrum.
